question: Does finishing a background indexing job recover answers lost by the three-claim budget?
selection: Try full completion first; if it fails regression guards, try resumable batches. Do not change thresholds or claim text based on results.
gates: All 258 previously fully indexed cases retain delivery, rank and negative returned count; preserve scope and 1000-token budget.
For matched capture orders, report all gains, losses and negative injections against the three-record budget, including heldout.
Cancellation before or during inference stops writes; clear/edit/delete and visibility protections remain effective.
Projects sharing a model directory must be able to schedule independent jobs; settings are checked throughout indexing.
interpretation: Synthetic availability experiment using previously evaluated claims, not fresh semantic generalization or end-to-end task success. Full indexing may reveal the existing model's false positives; report these separately. Indexing runs off the response path.
